purpose: Independent original source counterexamples for regular-expression, packed-bit, container-boundary, forwarding, atomic, cleanup-frame and runtime byte claims. Evaluation addresses and labels do not participate in selection.
reproduction_scope: Two fresh output directories per configuration on the same local Wine host. All 107 COFF objects are byte-identical. Assembly files are byte-identical except explicitly listed TTL/TITLE source-path directives; both raw hashes and the normalized hash are retained. This is not cross-host or hosted-CI qualification.
dependency_verification: Compiler packages and included headers were checked against SHA-256-verified package payloads. Compiler support libraries are recorded where cross-target execution requires them.
catalog_limit: Capture manifests historically recorded catalog-qualified.vsman for every toolset. Payload_catalog_sources below resolves each package payload against the actual downloaded catalogs, including catalog18.json for newer compilers. A downloaded catalog digest is not a verified channel-manifest signature: the older advertised digest differed, and no advertised digest match is claimed for catalog18.json. Package payload digests were checked separately.
